PDF Studio

plat · Web app star · 100% client-side lic · MIT ver · No account

A complete PDF editor that never uploads your file. Edit the text inside your PDF, fill forms, OCR scans, sign, redact and diff revisions — entirely in your browser.

▶ Open the editor GitHub ↗

Examples

Real things PDF Studio does — drawn from the docs, the demos and the repos.

EXAMPLE 1

Redact a contract

Burn social security and bank numbers out of a PDF so they can never be recovered.

EXAMPLE 2

Fill and sign a W-9

Complete form fields and add your signature without printing a page.

EXAMPLE 3

OCR a phone scan

Turn a crooked photo of a document into searchable, selectable text.

EXAMPLE 4

Diff two revisions

Compare proposal v2 against v3 and see exactly what changed.

Details

What ships with it.

  • Edit PDF text in place
  • Form filling + e-signature
  • On-device OCR for scans
  • True redaction (burned, not covered)
  • Revision diffing, on-device LLM helpers
